svg.title: Master Blaster - Play free at masterblaster.se
svg.desc: Master Blaster. Grapple. Blast. Bring the towers down. Play free at masterblaster.se. Dark navy banner with the game's white and cyan wordmark, red accents and a red play button.
svg.metadata: Original Master Blaster promotional vector artwork. Typography outlined from the project's Barlow Condensed Black and Inter SemiBold fonts; font licenses are retained in public/fonts.
